task.description: Design OIDC-05 validation coverage and update/add test specifications for dual bearer-token acceptance behavior. Ensure test matrix covers: OIDC JWT accepted via OIDC verifier, internal token accepted via IDN-04 verifier, malformed/indeterminate token returns HTTP 401 structured error, and no ambiguous fallback between token types. Produce or update tests/specs/OIDC-05.md and identify exact test cases for Step 04 execution.
acceptance_criteria: Spec covers both successful token-type paths and malformed/indeterminate 401 behavior
Spec maps cases to backend test files updated in Step 02

result.summary: Designed OIDC-05 validation coverage and produced a full deterministic token-routing matrix with explicit no-ambiguous-fallback checks mapped to executable Step 02 backend tests.
